readings: Considering only films whose `replacement_cost` is at least 20.99, work out for each `rating` the average `rental_duration` and the average ratio of `rental_rate` to `replacement_cost` (ignoring missing values). Then return a single row with the average of those per-rating average durations and the average of those per-rating average ratios, in that order and unrounded.
queries:
WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_duration,
    AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(replacement_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT AVG(avg_duration), AVG(avg_ratio)
FROM rating_averages
